sector_01.name: Cryo-Dock Awakening
sector_01.desc: Primary stasis bay of Orbital Station Zenith. Restore auxiliary circuits and calibrate movement.

sector_02.name: Jump Calibration Bay
sector_02.desc: Multi-tiered platforming calibration deck. Use jump thrusters to scale elevated structures.

sector_03.name: Crate Logistics Lab
sector_03.desc: Logistics handling sector. Push heavy storage cubes to bypass pressure barriers.

sector_04.name: Apex Vault I: Cryo Matrix
sector_04.desc: Sanctuary of the first Quantum Nexus Fragment. Guarded by an autonomous sentry drone.

sector_05.name: Dual Relay Chamber
sector_05.desc: Coupled pressure switch room. Both circuit plates must be weighed down simultaneously.

sector_06.name: Stacking Stepper Pit
sector_06.desc: Hazardous floor gap. Build a stepping staircase across the pit using industrial blocks.

sector_07.name: Laser Synchronization Maze
sector_07.desc: Labyrinth of reactive laser emitters. Synchronize terminal toggles to secure the Red Keycard.

items.name: Red Keycard
items.desc: Tier 2 Clearance for Reactor and Hangars.

sector_08.name: Quantum Inversion Matrix
sector_08.desc: Teleportation test chamber housing Nexus Fragment II. Route particle beams across elevations.

sector_09.name: Freight Receiving Dock
sector_09.desc: Primary cargo loading dock. Heavy freight containers and service lifts connect the bays.

sector_10.name: Deep Cryo Warehouse
sector_10.desc: Sub-zero storage bays. Slick metallic decks allow rapid crate momentum sliding.

sector_11.name: Hazardous Waste Sump
sector_11.desc: Sealed chemical disposal sector. Navigate narrow catwalks above toxic chemical pools.

sector_12.name: High-Value Vault III: AI Sub-Brain
sector_12.desc: Reinforced high-security vault storing Nexus Fragment III. Encased behind blast locks.

sector_13.name: Plasma Generator Hub
sector_13.desc: Primary plasma generation conduit. Pulsing reactors supply power across station bulkheads.

sector_14.name: High Voltage Transformer
sector_14.desc: High voltage substation. Push insulating blocks to intercept cascading laser arcs.

sector_15.name: Supercharger Sub-Station
sector_15.desc: Critical power relay storing the Green Keycard. Clearance permits passage to the Citadel.

items.name: Green Keycard
items.desc: Tier 3 Master Clearance for Omega Sanctum.

sector_16.name: Reactor Core Apex
sector_16.desc: Graviton Dynamo chamber harboring Nexus Fragment IV. Heavy radiation requires precision navigation.

sector_17.name: Drone Sentinel Perimeter
sector_17.desc: Front line defense matrix. Heavy autonomous sentry bots patrol the corridors.

sector_18.name: Interceptor Bastion
sector_18.desc: High alert interceptor redoubt. Guardian drones lock on and pursue intruders relentlessly.

sector_19.name: Master Access Antechamber
sector_19.desc: Outer antechamber to the Overmind Core. Nexus Fragment V must be unified to unlock Sector 20.

items.name: Nexus Fragment V: Chrono Resonance
items.desc: Fifth and final fragment. Harmonizes hyperspace matrix.

sector_20.name: Overmind Sanctum Core
sector_20.desc: Central nexus of Station Zenith. Unify all 5 Nexus Fragments and 3 Energy Cells to trigger hyperspace warp.

sector_00.name: Orbital Transit Grand Nexus
sector_00.desc: Grand central transit atrium connecting Wing B Cargo Facilities and Wing C Energy Reactor. Features dual moving transit elevators, perimeter mezzanine catwalks, and the central Fragment Receptacle.

items.name: Nexus High-Output Cell
items.desc: Power cell stabilizing central transit grid.

sector_21.name: Cargo Intake & Weigh Station
sector_21.desc: Automated freight receiving line. Heavy pallets must be positioned on calibrated pressure scales to disengage security laser fences.

sector_22.name: Hydraulic Lift Shaft
sector_22.desc: Massive hydraulic freight elevator. Ride the vertical lift platform to reach the upper gantry crane controls.

sector_23.name: Sub-Zero Stacking Bay
sector_23.desc: Cryogenic staging chamber. A sheer two-unit vertical bulkhead blocks the upper catwalk. Push crate from the raised ledge to stack atop the floor crate!

sector_24.name: Container Crane Gantry
sector_24.desc: Suspended high catwalks spanning across automated container bays. Secret air vent in the southeast ledge leads down to the maintenance substructure.

sector_25.name: Cryo-Storage Apex Vault
sector_25.desc: Deep stasis apex vault. Houses Nexus Fragment I: Cryo-Stasis Shard upon the central stepped dais guarded by dual containment lasers.

items.name: Nexus Fragment I: Cryo-Stasis Shard
items.desc: First core shard of the Orbital Transit Overmind.

sector_26.name: Sub-Deck Maintenance Vent (SECRET)
sector_26.desc: Concealed sub-deck utility crawlspace. Contains the rare Blue Cryo-Keycard and high-capacity cells discarded by station engineers.

items.name: Cryo-Engineering Blue Keycard
items.desc: Grants level-1 clearance to locked station doors.

sector_27.name: Cargo Chute Bypass (SHORTCUT)
sector_27.desc: High-level pneumatic express chute. Pull the interlock lever to permanently unlock a direct shortcut back into the Core Nexus Hub mezzanine!

sector_28.name: Plasma Distribution Junction
sector_28.desc: High-voltage plasma conduit junction. Pulsating floor conduits and magnetic transformers route energy across Wing C.

sector_29.name: High Voltage Stepping Conduits
sector_29.desc: Elevated capacitor towers rising above open zero-resistance conduit channels. Time jumps across stepping blocks over live laser barriers.

sector_30.name: Laser Reflection Relay Chamber
sector_30.desc: Optical laser sensor chamber. Push insulated ceramic mirror crates into the horizontal laser path to block the beam and unlock the north bulkhead.

sector_31.name: Electromagnetic Elevator Core
sector_31.desc: Twin alternating electromagnetic elevators ascending and descending in anti-phase. Leap between moving lifts to scale the north reactor gantry. Secret hatch under the south pit leads to the Capacitor Cache.

sector_32.name: The Reactor Core Heart
sector_32.desc: The superheated core heart of Station Zenith. Push both coolant dampening blocks onto receptor plates to extinguish the plasma containment laser grid and secure Nexus Fragment II.

items.name: Nexus Fragment II: Fusion Core Torus
items.desc: Second core shard of the Orbital Transit Overmind.

sector_33.name: Overcharged Capacitor Cache (SECRET)
sector_33.desc: Sub-reactor thermal sanctuary. Hidden under the electromagnetic elevator shaft, this chamber stores the Red Authorization Keycard and high-capacity cells.

items.name: Reactor Authorization Red Keycard
items.desc: Grants level-2 security clearance for reactor systems.

sector_34.name: High-Energy Service Conduit (SHORTCUT)
sector_34.desc: Overhead reactor exhaust service gantry. Operating the manual bypass wheel permanently unlocks the blast bulkhead directly into the Core Nexus Hub East Balcony!

sector_35.name: Cargo Stacking Testing Facility
sector_35.desc: Automated hydraulic proving ground. Stack freight crates atop one another to bypass the elevated optical tripwires and reach the high observation deck.

sector_36.name: Dual-Mass Hydraulic Crucible
sector_36.desc: Deep stabilization chamber. Two separate heavy hydraulic pressure pads require calibrated dual-tier freight stacks to release the magnetic security seal.

sector_37.name: High-Bay Vertical Stepper
sector_37.desc: Massive vertical shaft with tiered retaining walls. Build a 2-tier and 3-tier stepped cargo staircase to overcome the massive structural barricades.

sector_38.name: Laser Interception Gantry
sector_38.desc: Dual-frequency optical grid corridor. Standard crates only block the ground beam; you must stack two crates to occlude both upper and lower laser arrays simultaneously!

sector_39.name: Magnetic Freight Balancer
sector_39.desc: Precision magnetic balancing vault. Distribute calibrated weight stacks across 3 separate sensor nodes to disarm the central security field.

sector_40.name: Cryo-Crate Logistics Sorter
sector_40.desc: Sub-zero automated sorting deck. Navigate refrigerated slipways and stack heavy cargo to bridge across frozen conduits.

sector_41.name: Pneumatic Column Press
sector_41.desc: Massive hydraulic stamping pit. Stack three crates into a vertical column to trigger the high-overhead laser interlock sensor.

sector_42.name: Overhead Concourse Mezzanine
sector_42.desc: Sprawling high-bay concourse with suspended gantry walkways. Build multi-tiered stepping formations to climb to the elevated catwalks.

sector_43.name: Dual-Beam Deflection Vault
sector_43.desc: Synchronized laser containment grid. Use mobile crate stacks as physical ray-shields to occlude crossing beams while avoiding patrolling defense drones.

sector_44.name: Apex Stacking Colosseum
sector_44.desc: Grand master proving arena. Solve the ultimate stacking trial: position multiple 2-tier and 3-tier columns to activate all quadrant nodes and unlock Archival Vault Zero.

items.name: Grand Nexus Fragment Omega
items.desc: The grand prize of the Colosseum.

sector_45.name: Sub-Vault Maintenance Nook (SECRET)
sector_45.desc: Uncataloged sub-deck crawlspace discovered by stacking freight containers up to the high ventilation shafts in Sector 37.

sector_46.name: Cryo-Depot Hidden Catacomb (SECRET)
sector_46.desc: Ancient cryogenic reserve chamber hidden behind the upper ventilation grilles of Deep Cryo Warehouse Sector 10. Stacked crates allowed access.

sector_47.name: Decommissioned Drone Foundry (SECRET)
sector_47.desc: Mothballed sentinel assembly facility. Bypassed via a crate-stacking bridge over the high security barricade in Sector 18.

sector_48.name: Plasma Conductor Void (SECRET)
sector_48.desc: Unshielded energetic pocket reached by stacking crates as stepping platforms up the High Voltage Stepping Conduits of Sector 29.

sector_49.name: Archival Vault Zero (SECRET)
sector_49.desc: The lost station data sanctum. Only accessible by building a 3-crate column to reach the highest observation grille in Sector 44.

items.name: Zenith Master Crest
items.desc: Golden station crest proving complete exploration.

sector_50.name: High-Catwalk Express (SHORTCUT)
sector_50.desc: High-level cargo conveyor catwalk unlocked by stacking crates to reach the overhead hatch in Sector 03. Connects Sector 03 directly to Sector 09!

sector_51.name: Ventilation Bypass (SHORTCUT)
sector_51.desc: Wide pneumatic ventilation bypass. Opened by stacking 2 crates to clamber into the exhaust duct of Sector 06, leading straight into the Sector 13 Plasma Generator Hub!

sector_52.name: Service Elevator Maintenance (SHORTCUT)
sector_52.desc: High-speed vertical express lift. Stack 2 crates in Sector 17 to bypass the blast shield, unlocking an instant elevator back to the Core Nexus Hub mezzanine!
